about.title: About Business Loan Calculator - Commercial Financing Tool
about.description: The Business Loan Calculator is a professional financial tool designed to help entrepreneurs and business owners calculate monthly payments, total interest costs, and loan terms for commercial financing. Whether you're seeking working capital, equipment financing, or expansion funding, this calculator provides accurate payment estimates and helps you compare different loan scenarios to find the best financing option for your business needs.

faq.q: What types of business loans can I calculate?
faq.a: This calculator works for various business loans including term loans, SBA loans, equipment financing, working capital loans, and commercial real estate loans. Simply input the loan amount, interest rate, and term.

faq.q: How do I qualify for better business loan rates?
faq.a: Improve your business credit score, maintain strong cash flow, provide detailed financial statements, and consider offering collateral. Established businesses with 2+ years of operation typically qualify for better rates.

faq.q: Should I choose a shorter or longer loan term?
faq.a: Shorter terms mean higher monthly payments but less total interest paid. Longer terms reduce monthly payments but increase total cost. Choose based on your cash flow needs and growth projections.

faq.q: What's the difference between SBA and conventional business loans?
faq.a: SBA loans typically offer lower rates and longer terms but have stricter qualification requirements and longer approval processes. Conventional loans offer faster approval but may have higher rates and shorter terms.
